WITH charter_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE CharterNum = '756'
    AND MailCity = 'San Diego'
), sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cs.CDSCode,
    COALESCE(SUM(ss.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_testtakers
  FROM charter_schools cs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON cs.CDSCode = ss.cds
  GROUP BY cs.CDSCode
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_testtakers), 2) AS avg_test_takers
FROM sat_counts;

WITH SchoolSAT AS (
    SELECT
        sch.NCESSchool AS nces_school_id,
        sch.School AS school_name,
        sch.GSoffered AS grade_span_offered,
        sch.GSserved AS grade_span_served,
        COALESCE(SUM(st.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_sat_takers
    FROM schools sch
    LEFT JOIN satscores st ON st.cds LIKE sch.CDSCode || '%'
    WHERE sch.NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND sch.StatusType = 'Operating'
      AND sch.GSserved LIKE '%12%'  -- must serve grade 12
    GROUP BY sch.NCESSchool, sch.School, sch.GSoffered, sch.GSserved
),

-- Parse the lowest grade served by splitting GSserved (assuming it's a string like 'PK-12' or 'KG-12')

GradeOrder AS (
    SELECT 'PK' AS grade_label, 1 AS grade_order UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KG', 2 UNION ALL
    SELECT '01', 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT '02', 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT '03', 5 UNION ALL
    SELECT '04', 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT '05', 7 UNION ALL
    SELECT '06', 8 UNION ALL
    SELECT '07', 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT '08', 10 UNION ALL
    SELECT '09', 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
    SELECT '12', 14
),

ParsedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        nces_school_id,
        school_name,
        grade_span_offered,
        grade_span_served,
        SUBSTR(grade_span_served, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') > 0 THEN INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') - 1 ELSE LENGTH(grade_span_served) END) AS lowest_grade
    FROM SchoolSAT
    WHERE total_sat_takers = 0
),

ParsedGrades AS (
    SELECT
        ps.school_name,
        ps.grade_span_offered,
        ps.lowest_grade,
        go.grade_order
    FROM ParsedSchools ps
    JOIN GradeOrder go ON ps.lowest_grade = go.grade_label
),

MinGradeOrder AS (
    SELECT MIN(grade_order) AS earliest_grade_order FROM ParsedGrades
)

SELECT
    pg.school_name,
    pg.grade_span_offered
FROM ParsedGrades pg
JOIN MinGradeOrder mg ON pg.grade_order = mg.earliest_grade_order
ORDER BY pg.school_name;

WITH Cali_SBE_Schools AS (

),
School_SAT_Avg AS (
  SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'SCH'  -- ensure school level scores
  GROUP BY cds
),
Max_Avg_Score AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_reading_score) AS max_avg_reading
  FROM School_SAT_Avg
  WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM Cali_SBE_Schools)
)
SELECT c.School AS school_name,
       (c.MailStreet || ', ' || c.MailCity || ', ' || c.MailState || ' ' || c.MailZip) AS full_mailing_address
FROM Cali_SBE_Schools c
JOIN School_SAT_Avg s ON c.CDSCode = s.cds
JOIN Max_Avg_Score m ON s.avg_reading_score = m.max_avg_reading
ORDER BY c.School;

  SELECT CDSCode, 
         SUM([Enrollment (K-12)]) AS total_enrollment_k12,

MaxScore AS (

),

WITH FremontCounty AS (
  SELECT "County Name", "County Code"
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
CountySchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, "County Name", "Free Meal Count (K-12)", "FRPM Count (K-12)", "Charter School (Y/N)", "Enrollment (K-12)",
         ROUND("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", 2) AS free_meal_pct,
         ROUND("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 2) AS frpm_meal_pct
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "County Code" = (SELECT "County Code" FROM FremontCounty)
    AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
    AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
    AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '12'
),
SchoolSatScores AS (
  SELECT cds, (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
SchoolData AS (
  SELECT cs.CDSCode, cs."County Name", cs.free_meal_pct, cs.frpm_meal_pct, cs."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
         ss.total_sat_score
  FROM CountySchools cs
  LEFT JOIN SchoolSatScores ss ON cs.CDSCode = ss.cds
)
SELECT
  MAX("County Name") AS county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(frpm_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_meal_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(total_sat_score), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM SchoolData;

  FROM schools
  WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
    AND County = 'San Diego'
    AND District IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ym
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT '1980-01' AS ym UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-11' UNION ALL

)
SELECT
  (CAST(IFNULL(SUM(num_schools), 0) AS FLOAT) / 12.0) AS avg_schools_per_month
FROM all_months

WITH SchoolFreeMealRates AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.GSserved,
    s.Charter AS CharterFlag,
    MAX(fr.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]) AS MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM
    schools s
  JOIN
    frpm fr ON s.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode
  WHERE
    s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
  GROUP BY
    s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, s.Charter
), MaxRateSchools AS (
  SELECT
    MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM
    SchoolFreeMealRates
  ORDER BY
    MaxFreeMealRate DESC
  LIMIT 1
), SchoolSATPerformance AS (
  SELECT
    cds AS CDSCode,
    CASE
      WHEN enroll12 = 0 THEN 'No SAT Data'

    END AS SATPerformance

)

    SELECT s.id AS set_id, s.name AS set_name, s.code AS set_code, COUNT(c.id) AS card_count

    LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.type = 'commander'

      AND (c.layout IS NULL OR c.layout != 'alchemy')
    GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.code
),

LanguageCounts AS (
    SELECT c.setCode AS set_code, COUNT(DISTINCT f.language) AS language_count
    FROM cards c
    JOIN foreign_data f ON c.name = f.name
    GROUP BY c.setCode
),
MaxCardCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(card_count) AS max_count
    FROM Commander2020Cards
)

FROM Commander2020Cards c
LEFT JOIN LanguageCounts l ON c.set_code = l.set_code
JOIN MaxCardCount m ON c.card_count = m.max_count
ORDER BY c.set_id ASC
;

WITH LoanWithClient AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id AS client_district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
TopAmounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT amount
  FROM LoanWithClient
  ORDER BY amount DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
TopLoans AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM LoanWithClient
  WHERE amount >= (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM TopAmounts)
),
AccountTrans AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'deposit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deposits
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
LoanRegionCount AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
RegionAvgSalary AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A10), 2) AS avg_region_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY A3
),
ClientAgeOnDate AS (
  SELECT client_id, birth_date,
  (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER))
  - (strftime('%m%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m%d', birth_date)) AS age_on_2026_10_09
  FROM client
)
SELECT
  tl.client_id,
  ROUND(tl.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
  tl.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND(tl.payments * tl.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((tl.payments * tl.duration) - tl.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  tl.status AS loan_status,
  d.A2 AS district,
  d.A3 AS region,
  COALESCE(at.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(at.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  lrc.loans_in_region,
  ras.avg_region_salary,
  ca.age_on_2026_10_09 AS client_completed_age
FROM TopLoans tl
JOIN account a ON tl.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN AccountTrans at ON a.account_id = at.account_id
JOIN LoanRegionCount lrc ON d.A3 = lrc.region
JOIN RegionAvgSalary ras ON d.A3 = ras.region
JOIN ClientAgeOnDate ca ON tl.client_id = ca.client_id
ORDER BY tl.amount DESC, tl.loan_id
LIMIT 1000;

loan_counts AS (

trans_summaries AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'RECEIVE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.operation = 'WITHDRAW' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
external_counterparty_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> '' AND t.bank <> '우리' THEN t.account
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS external_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ranked_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.account_id,
    bi.district_name,
    bi.region,
    COALESCE(ts.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ec.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparty_count
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN branch_info bi ON ga.district_id = bi.district_id
  LEFT JOIN trans_summaries ts ON ga.account_id = ts.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN external_counterparty_counts ec ON ga.account_id = ec.account_id
)

  total_withdrawn,
  loan_count,

WITH account_owners AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        c.gender,
        CAST((strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) -
             (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_end_1996
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE a.district_id = 3
),

card_count AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),

loan_status_count AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
        MAX(CASE 
                WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 3
                WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 2
                WHEN l.status IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS max_status_rank
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),

loan_standing_label AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN num_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN max_status_rank = 3 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN max_status_rank = 2 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan_status_count
),

trans_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),

full_data AS (
    SELECT
        ao.account_id,
        ao.opening_date,
        ao.gender,
        ao.age_at_end_1996 AS age,
        COALESCE(cc.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
        COALESCE(ls.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
        COALESCE(ll.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
        COALESCE(ts.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(ts.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
        COALESCE(ts.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM account_owners ao
    LEFT JOIN card_count cc ON ao.account_id = cc.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_status_count ls ON ao.account_id = ls.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_standing_label ll ON ao.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ao.account_id = ts.account_id
),

ranked_data AS (
    SELECT
        fd.*, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fd.peak_balance DESC) AS rank
    FROM full_data fd
)

SELECT account_id, opening_date, gender, age, num_cards, num_loans, loan_standing, trans_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, rank
FROM ranked_data
ORDER BY rank, account_id
LIMIT 1000;
